What We're Building

Pillars of the New Commercial Operation

Manchester Organization

SRE & Observability
Evolutionary Stability

We use API monitoring and synthetic testing to capture instabilities before even if the commercial executive notices any slowness in the field, ensuring deliveries with zero regression.

  • Datadog Monitoring: Telemetry Dashboards measuring latency, error rates and critical API throttling of the PJ journey.
  • Synthetic and Unitary Tests: Automation of Unit tests on code base and synthetic (via Playwright) to validate online the opening flows.
  • Evolutionary Quality: Governance over the cycle of development life to eradicate regressions and bug readmissions.
Critical Mission Mobility

Strategic Mobility No Attrition

The tablet is our executive's main work tool. If it stops, the billing Lock. Our model eliminates waste of time through proactive support and monitoring synthetic, ensuring that the accreditation system is a competitive advantage, not an obstacle.

  • Direct Connection Channel

    A single point of contact integrated into the conquest system. With a touch, the executive triggers the support, and the telemetry is captured via Datadog SDK/RUM, sending the context of the transaction automatically for support, eliminating the need to explain the problem.

  • Step Priority Business

    The system identifies in which The stage of conquest the executive is. If blocking occurs in a service with commercial impediment, ticket automatically enters Manchester Protocol as Emergency (Red), ignoring slow screenings.

  • High Communication Reliability

    Bidirectional communication and transparent. The executive consults on the tablet who is the 'doctor' responsible and the ticket solution progress, keeping the calm and absolute focus on trading with The client.

We recognize the practical challenges of adoption. The main risk is the cultural transition of the IT team of the traditional model (reactive) for the Emergency Room model (proactive and predictive). We mitigate this impact with a phased change management program, ensuring the subtle acculturation of SRE practices and SDM without paralyzing the current support.

In short

What Service Operations 2.0 is

Service Operations 2.0 is an operation model that changes the reactive combat to incidents by systemic resilience: automation, AI and agile governance transform legacy operations into a capacity to conquer and retain customers.

  • Systemic resilience — the system absorbs failures rather than collapses at each incident.
  • Automation + AI — reduces toilet and anticipates problems before the customer feels.
  • Agile Governance — control without bureaucracy that stops delivery.
  • Customer focus — operation as a lever for achievement, not just cost.

Frequently Asked Questions

Frequently Asked Questions

What is Service Operations 2.0?

It is a model that evolves the service operation of reactive combat to incidents for systemic resilience, using automation, AI and agile governance. The goal is to transform legacy operations into a competitive advantage of customer experience.

How does it differ from traditional operation?

Traditional operation reacts to incidents; 2.0 designs the system to absorb faults and anticipate problems. Instead of measuring only cost and uptime, it measures customer impact and recovery capacity.

What is the role of AI and automation?

Reduce repetitive work (toil), detect risk patterns before impact and accelerate response. The AI enters as governed support for the decision, not as a black box on the critical path.
